**What is a Lazada scraper?** A Lazada scraper is a tool that automatically extracts product data from the Lazada marketplace, including product names, prices, descriptions, reviews, seller information, and images. It delivers this data in structured formats like CSV or JSON for analysis and business intelligence.  **Why would I need to scrape Lazada?** Businesses scrape Lazada for competitor price monitoring, market research, product trend analysis, and building datasets for pricing strategy. It is especially valuable for ecommerce companies operating in Southeast Asian markets who need to track thousands of products across multiple Lazada country sites.  **Which Lazada scraper is best for beginners?** Apify and Octoparse are the most beginner-friendly options. Apify offers pre-built Lazada actors you can run without coding, while Octoparse provides a visual point-and-click interface for building custom scraping workflows without any programming knowledge.  **Can Lazada scrapers handle multiple country sites?** Yes, most professional Lazada scrapers support all Lazada country domains including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Vietnam. Tools like Bright Data and Oxylabs offer geo-targeted proxy infrastructure to access each local Lazada site reliably.  **How much does a Lazada scraper cost?** Costs range from free tiers for small-scale scraping with tools like Apify and ScraperAPI, to mid-range plans at $49 to $149 per month, up to enterprise pricing with Bright Data and Oxylabs for high-volume data extraction running thousands of daily product lookups.  **Is scraping Lazada legal?** Scraping publicly available product data from Lazada is generally permissible for business intelligence purposes. However, you should always review Lazada’s terms of service for each country site and ensure your data collection practices comply with local data protection regulations in Southeast Asia.  **What data can I extract from Lazada?** Lazada scrapers can extract product titles, prices, discount percentages, seller names and ratings, customer reviews, product descriptions, images, category information, shipping details, and stock availability across all Lazada marketplace country sites.  **Which Lazada scraper is best for enterprise-scale extraction?** Bright Data is the top choice for enterprise-scale Lazada scraping with its massive proxy infrastructure, pre-built ecommerce datasets, and API-driven data delivery. Oxylabs and Decodo are also strong contenders for high-volume Lazada data collection across multiple Southeast Asian markets.

## FAQ

**What is a Myntra price tracker?** A Myntra price tracker is a tool that monitors product prices on the Myntra fashion platform over time. It records price history, detects price drops during sales and promotions, and sends alerts so you can buy products at their lowest price.  **How do Myntra price trackers work?** These tools monitor Myntra product pages at regular intervals, log pricing data, and compare current prices against historical lows. When a price drops below your set threshold or reaches its lowest point, you receive an alert through email, browser notification, or the app.  **Which Myntra price tracker is best for casual shoppers?** For casual shoppers, browser extensions like PriceBefore and BuyHatke are the easiest options. They show price history directly on Myntra product pages with no setup required and alert you when prices drop on items you are watching.  **Can I track Myntra prices during sales events?** Yes, price trackers are especially useful during Myntra’s Big Fashion Festival, End of Reason Sale, and seasonal clearances. They help you verify whether a sale price is genuinely the lowest or just a marketing discount compared to the recent price history.  **Are there free Myntra price trackers available?** Yes, several free options exist including browser extensions like PriceBefore and BuyHatke that show price history charts. Price History apps on Android also offer free basic tracking. Premium features like bulk tracking and API access require paid tools like Bright Data.  **Which tool is best for businesses tracking Myntra prices?** Bright Data is the strongest option for business-level Myntra price intelligence. It provides structured datasets, API access, and scalable infrastructure for tracking thousands of products simultaneously, which consumer-grade extensions cannot handle.  **Can I track prices for specific Myntra categories?** Yes, most Myntra price trackers let you monitor specific products by adding their URLs. Some tools also support category-level monitoring where you can track price trends across entire product categories like men’s shoes or women’s ethnic wear.  **How accurate are Myntra price trackers?** Accuracy depends on how frequently the tool checks prices. Browser extensions typically update when you visit a product page, while dedicated tracking tools check at regular intervals. Enterprise solutions like Bright Data offer the highest accuracy with frequent automated checks.

## Final Thoughts

The best Myntra scraper for you depends on your volume, technical ability, and budget. For enterprises and data teams that need large, reliable, and immediately usable datasets, Bright Data stands out as the clear first choice. For developers who prefer an API-first approach, Oxylabs and Infatica are strong contenders. If you prefer a fully managed, no-code experience, ScrapeIt and RetailGators handle everything from setup to delivery. And for lightweight solo use, Data Excavator and Apify offer accessible entry points without heavy investment.

Whichever tool you choose, ensure your data collection practices comply with Myntra’s terms of service and applicable privacy regulations!

## FAQ

**What is a Myntra scraper?** A Myntra scraper is a tool that automatically extracts product data from the Myntra fashion ecommerce platform, including product names, prices, images, descriptions, sizes, reviews, and seller information. It delivers structured data for analysis, price tracking, and competitive research.  **Why would I need to scrape Myntra?** Businesses scrape Myntra for competitor price monitoring, fashion trend analysis, product catalog building, and customer sentiment research. Researchers and analysts use Myntra data to understand pricing patterns, discount strategies, and product assortment across India’s largest fashion marketplace.  **Which Myntra scraper is best for beginners?** Data Excavator and Apify are the most beginner-friendly options. Data Excavator is a lightweight browser extension requiring no coding, while Apify provides pre-built scraping actors with a visual interface that simplifies the entire data extraction workflow.  **Can Myntra scrapers extract review and rating data?** Yes, most professional Myntra scrapers can extract customer reviews, star ratings, review counts, and detailed feedback alongside product data. This information is valuable for sentiment analysis, product research, and understanding customer preferences in the Indian fashion market.  **How much does a Myntra scraper cost?** Costs range from free browser extensions like Data Excavator for small-scale use, to mid-range API solutions at $49 to $149 per month with ZenRows or ScraperAPI, up to enterprise pricing with Bright Data and Oxylabs for high-volume data extraction across thousands of products.  **Is scraping Myntra legal?** Scraping publicly available product data is generally permissible for business intelligence. However, you should review Myntra’s terms of service and ensure compliance with Indian data protection regulations. Most businesses use Myntra scrapers for legitimate competitor research and market analysis.  **What data can I extract from Myntra?** Myntra scrapers can extract product titles, prices, discount percentages, brand names, category information, size availability, product images, customer reviews, ratings, seller details, and product descriptions across all Myntra fashion and lifestyle categories.  **Which Myntra scraper is best for large-scale data collection?** Bright Data is the strongest option for enterprise-scale Myntra scraping with its pre-built ecommerce datasets, massive proxy infrastructure, and flexible API delivery. Oxylabs and Infatica are also strong alternatives for high-volume fashion data extraction from Myntra.

Amazon prices can change quickly — a product might drop 30% one day and rise again the next.  If you are not tracking prices, you are almost certainly overpaying — or missing critical competitive intelligence.

Whether you are a casual shopper looking for the best deal or a business analyst monitoring rival pricing strategies, an Amazon price tracker makes your life easier. This guide covers the 10 best tools available right now, what makes each one stand out, and which one fits your specific needs.

## Top 10 Best Amazon Price Tracking Tools in 2026

Looking for the best Amazon price tracking tools? Here are the top 10 options that help you stay on top of price changes and get the best deals.

## 1. Bright Data

[Bright Data](/providers/bright-data/) offers a robust Amazon price tracking platform designed for businesses, developers, and data teams. It provides accurate pricing data at scale, eliminating the need to build a custom solution. The platform is powered by a proxy network with over 150 million IPs, allowing it to navigate Amazon’s anti-bot protections effortlessly. Users can access clean, structured data regardless of the volume, ensuring seamless integration for large-scale projects. Bright Data makes it easy to track prices without dealing with complex technical issues, delivering reliable and efficient pricing insights every time.

**Key Features:**

- **Real-time price monitoring:** Tracks live product prices across all Amazon marketplaces with instant alerts and updates.

- **Amazon Price Scraper API: **Extracts pricing data programmatically at massive scale — supports up to 5,000 URLs per single request.

- **MCP Server integration:** Plugs directly into AI agents and automated workflows for hands-free Amazon data extraction.

- **No-code scraper: **A visual interface lets non-technical users collect pricing data without writing a single line of code.

- **70+ AI integrations: **Works with LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and many more platforms.

**Pros**

- Unlimited scalability — handles enterprise-level data volumes with ease

- Built-in CAPTCHA solving and automatic IP rotation for uninterrupted scraping

- Multiple delivery formats including JSON, CSV, webhooks, Amazon S3, Snowflake, and more

**Cons**

- Requires some technical knowledge to unlock advanced API and integration features

- Pricing is usage-based, which can add up for very high-volume use cases

- Overkill for casual shoppers who only want to track a handful of products

**Pricing:** Free trial available. Amazon Price Scraper starts at $1.50 per 1,000 records. Managed service plans start at $250/month.

## Final Thoughts

The right Amazon price tracker depends on what you are trying to accomplish. If you are a casual shopper, free tools like CamelCamelCamel, Karma, or Sugar will serve you well. If you are an Amazon seller looking for competitive intelligence, Keepa, Helium 10, or Prisync offer the market-level depth you need. For businesses and developers that require large-scale, programmatic, AI-ready price data, Bright Data is the clear leader — combining enterprise-grade infrastructure, flexible delivery options, and deep AI integrations into a single platform.

Whatever your use case, one thing is certain: tracking Amazon prices beats guessing every single time.

## FAQ

**What is an Amazon price tracker?** An Amazon price tracker is a tool that monitors product prices on Amazon over time. It records price history, sends alerts when prices drop below your target, and helps shoppers and businesses make informed purchasing or competitive pricing decisions based on real data.  **How do Amazon price trackers work?** These tools regularly check Amazon product pages, log current prices, and compare them against historical data. When a price drops or meets a threshold you set, the tracker sends an alert via email, browser notification, or app push notification so you can act quickly.  **Is CamelCamelCamel still the best free Amazon price tracker?** CamelCamelCamel remains one of the most popular free options with solid price history charts and alert features. However, tools like Keepa now offer more detailed data including sales rank tracking, and enterprise solutions like Bright Data provide far more depth for business use.  **Can businesses use Amazon price trackers for competitor monitoring?** Yes, many Amazon price trackers are built specifically for business intelligence. Tools like Bright Data, Prisync, and Price2Spy let businesses monitor competitor pricing at scale, track MAP compliance, analyze pricing trends, and feed data into automated repricing strategies.  **Are Amazon price trackers free to use?** Some are free for basic use, including CamelCamelCamel and Keepa’s browser extension. More advanced features like bulk tracking, API access, historical data exports, and enterprise-level monitoring typically require paid plans ranging from $10 to several hundred dollars monthly.  **Which Amazon price tracker is best for large-scale data collection?** Bright Data is the clear leader for enterprise-scale Amazon price tracking. It offers structured datasets, real-time scraping infrastructure, and AI-ready data delivery that supports millions of product lookups, which goes far beyond what consumer tools like CamelCamelCamel can provide.  **Can I track Amazon prices on my phone?** Yes, several trackers offer mobile apps or mobile-friendly experiences. Keepa has a popular mobile interface, and tools like Honey work through browser extensions on mobile. For dedicated mobile tracking, apps like AmazonPriceTracker and Earny provide push notifications for price drops.  **How often do Amazon price trackers update their data?** Update frequency varies by tool. Free tools like CamelCamelCamel typically check prices a few times per day. Premium tools like Keepa and Bright Data can update hourly or near real-time, which matters for competitive markets where prices change rapidly throughout the day.

Choosing the right price tracking tool depends on your business size, industry, and budget. Bright Data stands out as the most powerful and flexible solution, especially for enterprises that need comprehensive data coverage and AI-driven analysis.

## FAQ

**What are price tracking tools?** Price tracking tools are software solutions that automatically monitor competitor pricing, detect price changes, and alert businesses in real time. They help ecommerce stores, retailers, and brands make data-driven pricing decisions to stay competitive and protect profit margins.  **How do price tracking tools work?** These tools use web scraping and data extraction to collect pricing data from competitor websites, marketplaces, and online stores. They continuously monitor target URLs, compare prices against your own, and deliver reports or alerts when changes occur so you can react quickly.  **What should I look for in a price tracking tool?** Key features to consider include the number of competitors and products you can track, update frequency, marketplace coverage like Amazon and eBay, pricing alerts, historical data analysis, MAP monitoring capabilities, integration options, and overall pricing relative to your budget.  **Are price tracking tools legal to use?** Yes, tracking publicly available pricing data is generally legal. Most price tracking tools collect data that any consumer can see on a website. However, you should always review the terms of service of target websites and ensure your usage complies with local data protection regulations.  **Can small businesses benefit from price tracking tools?** Absolutely. Small businesses often benefit the most because they lack the resources to manually monitor competitors. Affordable tools like Prisync, Competera, and Price2Spy offer plans designed for smaller product catalogs, helping small teams compete with larger retailers on pricing strategy.  **What is MAP monitoring and why does it matter?** MAP stands for Minimum Advertised Price. MAP monitoring tools track whether resellers and distributors are advertising your products below the agreed minimum price. This protects brand value and ensures fair competition across your distribution channels.  **How often do price tracking tools update pricing data?** Update frequency varies by tool and plan. Some tools like Prisync and Competera offer daily updates on standard plans, while premium tiers can deliver near real-time monitoring with updates every few hours. Choose a frequency that matches how quickly your market prices change.  **Can price tracking tools integrate with my ecommerce platform?** Yes, most leading price tracking tools offer integrations with popular ecommerce platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento, as well as marketplaces like Amazon and eBay. Some also provide API access for custom integrations with your existing business intelligence systems.

## FAQ

**What is a Grok scraper?** A Grok scraper is a tool that automatically sends prompts to the Grok AI platform, collects the generated responses, and returns structured data including answer text, citations, and metadata. These tools help businesses monitor AI visibility and gather AI-generated insights at scale.  **Why would I need to scrape Grok?** Businesses scrape Grok for GEO tracking to see how their brand appears in AI responses, competitor analysis to monitor mentions and recommendations, research to collect AI-generated data at scale, and AI visibility monitoring to understand how Grok references their products or services.  **Is scraping Grok difficult?** Yes, scraping Grok presents challenges including dynamic page rendering, anti-bot protections, session management, and rate limiting. Dedicated scrapers handle these issues automatically with rotating proxies, headless browsers, and built-in retry logic so you get reliable results.  **Which Grok scraper is best for beginners?** ScraperAPI and Apify are the most beginner-friendly options. ScraperAPI offers a simple API that handles proxies and rendering automatically. Apify provides pre-built actors and a visual interface that lets you start scraping without deep technical knowledge.  **Can I get structured data from Grok scrapers?** Yes, most Grok scrapers return structured output in JSON or CSV format, including the AI response text, cited sources, links, and metadata. Tools like Bright Data and cloro specialize in delivering clean, structured data ready for analysis and reporting.  **What is the difference between Grok scrapers and general web scrapers?** Grok scrapers are specifically designed or configured to handle the unique challenges of scraping AI platforms, including session-based interactions, dynamic content loading, and prompt-response workflows. General web scrapers can be adapted for this purpose but may require more setup and customization.  **How much do Grok scrapers cost?** Pricing varies widely. Free tiers are available from tools like ScraperAPI and Apify for small-scale use. Paid plans typically start from $49 to $99 per month for moderate usage, while enterprise solutions like Bright Data and Oxylabs charge based on data volume and can exceed several hundred dollars monthly.  **Can Grok scrapers handle bulk scraping jobs?** Yes, tools like Bright Data, Oxylabs, and Decodo are built for high-volume bulk scraping with infrastructure that supports thousands of concurrent requests. They handle proxy rotation, anti-bot bypass, and rate limiting automatically to ensure reliable data collection at scale.

> Google Gemini has quickly become one of the most popular AI models for generating answers, recommendations, and citations. Businesses tracking brand visibili...

Google Gemini has quickly become one of the most popular AI models for generating answers, recommendations, and citations. Businesses tracking brand visibility in AI search results, researchers collecting AI-generated data, and developers building GEO monitoring tools all need a reliable way to extract structured data from Gemini at scale.

That is where Gemini scrapers come in. These tools automatically send prompts to Gemini, collect the generated responses, and return structured data including answer text, citations, links, and metadata. Instead of manually copying results or dealing with API rate limits, you get automated, scalable, and consistent data collection.

In this guide, we’ll discuss the 10 best Gemini scrapers available right now, covering what each tool does, what makes it stand out, and what it costs. Let’s dive in!

Gemini scraping is becoming a core capability for teams focused on GEO strategy, brand monitoring, and AI research. The right tool depends on your scale, technical requirements, and budget. ## FAQ

**What is a Gemini scraper?** A Gemini scraper is a tool that automatically sends prompts to Google Gemini, collects the AI-generated responses, and returns structured data including answer text, citations, links, and metadata. These tools enable businesses to monitor brand visibility in AI search results at scale.  **Why is scraping Google Gemini important for businesses?** As more users rely on AI-generated answers instead of traditional search results, brands need to know how Gemini references their products and services. Scraping Gemini helps track AI visibility, monitor competitor mentions, and optimize content strategy for generative engine optimization.  **What data can I extract from Gemini?** Gemini scrapers can extract the full AI response text, cited sources and URLs, brand mentions, product recommendations, related questions, and structured metadata. This data helps businesses understand their presence in AI-generated search results and adjust their content accordingly.  **Which Gemini scraper is best for GEO monitoring?** cloro is the most purpose-built option for GEO and AI brand monitoring, offering dedicated tracking for how brands appear in AI responses. Bright Data also excels with its Web Scraper API that delivers structured Gemini data at enterprise scale with comprehensive citation extraction.  **Can I scrape Gemini without coding skills?** Yes, several tools offer no-code options. Apify provides pre-built Gemini actors with a visual interface. Octoparse offers a point-and-click scraper builder. ZenRows and ScraperAPI provide simple APIs that handle all the technical complexity behind a single endpoint.  **How is Gemini scraping different from regular web scraping?** Gemini scraping involves interacting with an AI model through prompts and collecting dynamically generated responses, which is fundamentally different from scraping static web pages. It requires handling JavaScript rendering, session management, and prompt-response workflows that standard scrapers are not designed for.  **What does a Gemini scraper cost?** Costs range from free tiers for small-scale testing with tools like ScraperAPI and ZenRows, to $49 to $149 per month for mid-level plans, up to custom enterprise pricing with Bright Data and Oxylabs for high-volume data collection running thousands of daily queries.  **Is it legal to scrape Google Gemini?** Scraping publicly available AI responses is generally permissible, but you should review Google’s terms of service and applicable data regulations. Most businesses use Gemini scrapers for legitimate purposes like brand monitoring, competitive intelligence, and market research within acceptable usage boundaries.

## [Choosing Between Oxylabs and Zyte for Web Scraping in 2026](https://scrapingproxies.best/blog/comparison/oxylabs-vs-zyte/)

> Web scraping plays a crucial role in how modern companies collect and use online data. Businesses rely on it to track product prices, gather leads, study com...

Web scraping plays a crucial role in how modern companies collect and use online data. Businesses rely on it to track product prices, gather leads, study competitors, and even collect information for training AI systems. To do this effectively, you need a reliable tool built for large-scale data extraction. Two platforms that often come up in discussions are Oxylabs and Zyte.

Oxylabs is widely known for its huge proxy network and strong infrastructure designed for high-volume scraping tasks. Zyte, on the other hand, is popular among developers for its powerful scraping tools and close integration with the Scrapy framework. Both platforms are capable solutions, but they focus on slightly different users and workflows. In this guide, we compare their features, pricing, performance, and use cases to help you decide which one best fits your needs!

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) is a Lithuanian company founded in 2015. It has grown into one of the world’s largest proxy service providers. The company specializes in building and managing large pools of residential, datacenter, mobile, and ISP proxy IP addresses.

Oxylabs serves over 4,000 clients globally. These include Fortune 500 companies, academic institutions like Stanford, and investigative journalism organizations. Its core promise is simple: give businesses reliable, anonymous access to public web data at scale.

Beyond proxies, Oxylabs has expanded into scraping APIs and AI-powered data tools. The platform now covers the entire data extraction pipeline, from connecting to a target site to delivering structured, parsed results.

## Zyte

[Zyte](/providers/zyte/) (formerly Scrapinghub) is an Irish company with roots going back to 2010. It is the team behind Scrapy, the most widely used open-source web scraping framework in the world. This gives Zyte a unique developer credibility that few competitors can match.

Zyte’s main product is the Zyte API, an all-in-one web scraping interface that handles unblocking, browser rendering, and AI-powered data extraction in a single endpoint. It also offers Scrapy Cloud for hosting spiders, a VS Code-based Web Scraping Copilot, and a Managed Data service where Zyte’s experts build and maintain custom data feeds for clients.

Zyte positions itself as a full-stack data extraction partner, with a strong focus on legal compliance and enterprise reliability.

## Product and Pricing Comparison

### **Oxylabs Product Line**

#### **Residential Proxies**

Oxylabs’ [Residential Proxies](/residential-proxies/) are the flagship product. The pool contains over 175 million IP addresses sourced from real user devices. These IPs rotate automatically, making it nearly impossible for websites to detect and block scraping activity.

**Key features include:**

- 175M+ residential IPs across 195+ countries

- Average response time of 0.41 seconds

- 99.82% average success rate

- Advanced geo-targeting: country, state, city, coordinates, ASN

- Powered by QUIC protocol for faster connections

- Support for HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5

Residential Proxies are ideal for e-commerce scraping, ad verification, SEO monitoring, and any use case where websites aggressively block datacenter IPs.

**Pricing** starts at $4 per GB for the Basic plan (5GB/month at $20), dropping as volume increases. 

#### **Datacenter Proxies**

Oxylabs’ [Datacenter Proxies](/datacenter-proxies/) offer a cost-effective solution for high-volume scraping where speed matters more than residential-level anonymity. The pool includes over 2 million IPs across 32+ locations.

**Key features include:**

- 0.25 second average response time

- 99.9% uptime

- Unlimited bandwidth with fair usage policy

- Both pay-per-IP and pay-per-traffic billing options

- Free trial with 5 IPs, no credit card required

**Pricing **starts at $1.20/IP per month or $0.59/GB on the traffic-based plan. These proxies work great for price monitoring, review tracking, and website change detection, where speed is critical.

#### **Mobile Proxies**

Oxylabs also offers powerful [Mobile Proxies](/mobile-proxies/) designed to simulate real mobile user traffic. The network includes more than 20 million mobile IP addresses from 3G, 4G, 5G, and LTE networks available in 140+ countries. Since these IPs come from real mobile carriers, websites treat them like genuine mobile users, making them much harder to detect or block during scraping tasks.

**Key features include: **

- 20M+ real mobile IP addresses

- Coverage in 140+ countries

- Automatic IP rotation

- Support for HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols

- 30-minute sticky sessions available

**Pricing** start at $5.40 per GB on the pay-as-you-go plan, while larger subscription plans can reduce the cost to around $7.50 per GB for 80GB per month.

#### **ISP Proxies**

[ISP Proxies](/isp-proxies/), also known as static residential proxies, combine the performance of datacenter IPs with the trustworthiness of residential IPs. They come from real Internet Service Providers like Comcast, BT Group, and Deutsche Telekom.

Oxylabs offers two variants: shared ISP Proxies (up to 3 users per IP) and Dedicated ISP Proxies (exclusively yours). Both support unlimited-duration sessions, meaning you can hold the same IP for as long as you need.

**Key features include:**

- 99.9% success rate on challenging targets

- HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 support

- Premium ASN providers: Comcast, Orange, Lumen, BT Group, Cox

- 17 locations including US, UK, Germany, France, Canada

**Pricing: **ISP Proxies start at $1.60/IP/month (10 IPs) and Dedicated ISP starts at $3.20/IP/month (5 IPs).

#### **Web Scraper API **

Oxylabs also provides powerful tools for users who want clean, structured data instead of raw website code. The Web Scraper API allows businesses to collect data from many popular websites and receive it in a ready-to-use format. Instead of building and maintaining scrapers manually, the API handles the complex work such as parsing pages, managing proxies, and bypassing blocks. One of its newest features is self-healing parser presets, which automatically adjust when a website changes its layout.

**Key features include:**

- Structured data output instead of raw HTML

- Self-healing parsers that adapt to site layout changes

- AI-powered scraping tools for non-technical users

- Natural language prompts to generate data queries

- Built-in proxy and anti-block infrastructure

- Free trial with up to 2,000 results

**Pricing** starts with a free trial that lets you run up to 2,000 results without a credit card, while paid plans start at $49 per month.

### **Zyte Product Line**

#### **Zyte API**

The Zyte API is Zyte’s core offering. It is an all-in-one web scraping endpoint that automatically handles three major challenges: unblocking websites, rendering JavaScript-heavy pages in a headless browser, and extracting structured data using AI.

Instead of managing separate proxy rotation, browser automation, and parsing scripts, you send a single API request and get clean, structured data back. This dramatically reduces development overhead.

**Key features include:**

- Automatic anti-bot bypass and proxy rotation

- Built-in headless browser for JavaScript rendering

- AI-powered extraction for products, articles, jobs, real estate listings, and more

- Network intercept for capturing and modifying requests

- Geolocation targeting

- Pay-per-use pricing with a free tier

Zyte API is ideal for teams building production-grade scrapers who want to minimize infrastructure management. It works especially well for e-commerce product data, news articles, flight pricing, and business listings.

**Pricing** follows a pay-as-you-go model, starting from $0.13–$1.27 per 1,000 HTTP responses and $1.01–$16.08 per 1,000 browser-rendered responses, with monthly commitments.

#### **Web Scraping Copilot**

Web Scraping Copilot is an AI-powered VS Code extension built specifically for web scraping developers. It works as a smart coding assistant that understands scraping frameworks, especially Scrapy, and helps developers build scraping scripts faster. Instead of writing complex code manually, you can simply describe what data you want to extract, and the tool generates the scraping logic automatically. 

The extension can create selectors, parsing rules, and testing setups, making it easier to build reliable scrapers. It also understands common anti-bot protections and can recommend solutions such as integrating the Zyte API when blocks occur. 

**Key features include: **

- AI assistant designed specifically for web scraping

- Works directly inside VS Code

- Generates Scrapy spiders automatically

- Supports CSS and XPath selector generation

- Suggests anti-bot bypass strategies

- Automatically integrates Zyte API when needed

- Creates testable scraping code and fixtures

#### **Scrapy and Scrapy Cloud**

Zyte created and maintains Scrapy, the open-source Python framework that millions of developers use for web scraping. This gives Zyte enormous credibility in the developer community and a deep ecosystem of plugins, tutorials, and community support.

Scrapy Cloud is the cloud hosting platform for Scrapy spiders. Consider it as Heroku for web scrapers. You deploy your spider, set a schedule, and Scrapy Cloud handles everything from scaling to monitoring.

**Key features include: **

- Deploy via command line or GitHub integration

- Intelligent scheduling and real-time dashboard

- Built-in monitoring with Spidermon support

- Customizable containers for complex setups

- 7-day data retention on the free tier, 120 days on paid plans

**Pricing:** Scrapy Cloud pricing starts at free (1 concurrent crawl, 1-hour crawl time) and scales to $ 9 per unit per month on professional plans.

## Performance and Reliability Comparison

When comparing performance, Oxylabs stands out for its raw proxy speed and reliability. Zyte API works a little differently, which makes direct comparison more difficult. Instead of simply providing proxies, it manages the full scraping process. This includes handling website blocks, rendering pages in a browser, and extracting the required data. Because of this integrated approach, Zyte focuses more on automation than raw proxy performance. The platform reports a 99%+ success rate for retrieving public data.

Both platforms also provide very reliable infrastructure. Oxylabs guarantees 99.9% uptime for its proxy network and operates through ISO 27001-certified data centers. Zyte offers a similar 99.9% uptime for Scrapy Cloud and benefits from more than 15 years of experience in web scraping technology.

In simple terms, Oxylabs is excellent for high-volume proxy routing, while Zyte is better suited for fully automated scraping workflows.

## Final Verdict

Oxylabs and Zyte are both powerful tools for web scraping, but they serve different types of users. Oxylabs is best for companies that mainly need a strong proxy network. It offers millions of residential, mobile, ISP, and datacenter IPs that work well for large scraping projects. If your team already has scraping scripts and only needs reliable IP rotation and high success rates, Oxylabs is a great choice.

Zyte, on the other hand, focuses on a full scraping platform. It helps developers manage the entire scraping process, from writing spiders to handling anti‑bot protection and delivering structured data.

Some organizations even use both tools together. Oxylabs can provide the proxy infrastructure, while Zyte manages automated scraping workflows. The right choice depends on your project size, technical skills, and how much infrastructure you want to manage yourself.

## FAQ

**What is the main difference between Oxylabs and Zyte?** Oxylabs focuses on providing a massive proxy network with over 100 million IPs for enterprise-level data collection. Zyte specializes in end-to-end web scraping tools, including automated extraction and deep Scrapy framework integration, making it more developer-oriented.  **Which platform is better for large-scale web scraping?** For raw proxy infrastructure and high-volume requests, Oxylabs is the stronger choice with its extensive IP pool and dedicated account management. Zyte is better if you need a complete scraping pipeline with built-in anti-bot handling and data extraction.  **How does pricing compare between Oxylabs and Zyte?** Oxylabs uses usage-based pricing starting around $49 per month for datacenter proxies and higher for residential plans. Zyte offers a free tier for small projects and scales based on successful requests through its API, making it more accessible for startups.  **Can I use Zyte with Scrapy?** Yes, Zyte was originally built by the team behind Scrapy and offers tight integration through Zyte API and Scrapy Cloud. This makes it a natural choice for developers already using the Scrapy framework for their scraping projects.  **Does Oxylabs offer a scraping API like Zyte?** Yes, Oxylabs offers a Web Scraper API that handles JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHA solving, and structured data delivery. However, Zyte’s scraping tools are more deeply integrated into a full extraction workflow compared to Oxylabs’ proxy-first approach.  **Which service has better anti-bot bypass capabilities?** Both platforms handle anti-bot protection effectively. Zyte uses smart fingerprinting and automatic retries built into its API. Oxylabs relies on its massive [rotating proxy](/rotating-proxies/) pool and Web Unblocker tool to bypass detection on difficult target sites.  **Is Zyte or Oxylabs better for beginners?** Zyte is generally more beginner-friendly thanks to its free tier, clear API documentation, and automated scraping tools. Oxylabs is better suited for teams with existing technical infrastructure that need high-performance proxy access at scale.  **Can I use Oxylabs and Zyte together?** Yes, some organizations combine both platforms. Oxylabs can provide the proxy infrastructure for custom scraping setups, while Zyte manages automated scraping workflows including spider management, anti-bot handling, and structured data delivery.

## [Oxylabs and ZenRows Head-to-Head: Finding the Better Scraping Tool](https://scrapingproxies.best/blog/comparison/oxylabs-vs-zenrows/)

> Web scraping is now an important tool for businesses that want to collect useful information from the internet. Companies use it to track competitor prices, ...

Web scraping is now an important tool for businesses that want to collect useful information from the internet. Companies use it to track competitor prices, study market trends, gather customer reviews, and even train AI models with fresh data. But scraping websites today is not easy because many sites use security systems that block automated requests. That is why choosing the right scraping platform is very important.

Two popular solutions in this space are Oxylabs and ZenRows. Both help users collect public web data, but they work in different ways. Oxylabs focuses on a large proxy network and powerful infrastructure for big data projects. ZenRows takes a simpler approach with an easy‑to‑use scraping API that handles most technical challenges automatically. In this article, we will compare the two platforms to help you decide which one best suits your needs. Let’s dive in!.

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) was founded in 2015 and is based in Lithuania. It has grown into one of the largest proxy providers in the world. The company serves over 4,000 clients globally and offers a full suite of tools for web data extraction.

Oxylabs is known for its massive residential proxy pool, which contains over 175 million IPs. It also provides datacenter proxies, [mobile proxies](/mobile-proxies/), [ISP proxies](/isp-proxies/), and multiple scraper APIs. The company targets mid-to-large enterprises that need high-volume, reliable scraping infrastructure.

**Key stats at a glance:**

- 175M+ residential IPs

- 188+ supported countries

- 99%+ average success rate

- Average response time under 0.5 seconds

- Trusted by Stanford, Forbes, Trivago, and more

## ZenRows

[ZenRows](/providers/zenrows-review/) is a web scraping API provider that positions itself as an all-in-one solution for developers and businesses. Its main product is a Universal Scraper API that handles JavaScript rendering, anti-bot bypassing, and structured data output in a single API call.

ZenRows is designed for speed of integration. You can be up and running in under five minutes. It focuses heavily on bypassing tools like Cloudflare, DataDome, and PerimeterX — the kinds of anti-bot systems that trip up traditional scrapers.

**Key stats at a glance:**

- 55M+ residential proxy IPs

- 99%+ success rate against Cloudflare and major anti-bots

- 55M+ residential proxy IPs

- Proxies available in 185+ countries

- Trusted by 2,000+ organizations

- LLM-ready outputs including Markdown and JSON

## Product and Pricing Comparison

### **Oxylabs Products and Pricing**

#### **Residential Proxies**

Oxylabs [Residential Proxies](/residential-proxies/) are the flagship product. The pool contains over 175 million IP addresses from real devices. These IPs rotate automatically and support precise geo-targeting down to the city and ASN level.

The proxies are filtered by latency, bandwidth, and scraping history. This means you always connect to high-quality IPs. The average response time is 0.41 seconds, and the success rate is 99.82%.

**Best use cases:**

- E-commerce price scraping

- Ad verification across geographies

- Market research requiring location-specific data

- Travel fare aggregation

**Pricing: **Plans start at $4 per GB. The Basic plan starts at $20/month for 5 GB.

#### **Mobile Proxies**

Oxylabs Mobile Proxies provide access to a massive network of over 20 million real mobile IP addresses across 3G, 4G, and 5G networks worldwide. These IPs come from real mobile devices and are available in over 140 countries.

The service also includes automatic IP rotation, which changes the IP address regularly to avoid detection. If you need a stable connection, you can enable sticky sessions that keep the same IP address for up to 30 minutes during your scraping tasks.

**Best use cases:**

- App store data scraping

- Mobile ad verification

- Review monitoring from mobile networks

**Pricing**: Pay-as-you-go starts at $5.40/GB. Monthly plans start at $59/month for 12 GB. 

#### **Datacenter Proxies**

Oxylabs [Datacenter Proxies](/datacenter-proxies/) are the most cost-effective option in the lineup. They offer a pool of over 2 million IPs across 40+ countries. These proxies are ideal for high-volume scraping tasks where speed matters more than appearing as a residential user.

They support HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols. You can choose between pay-per-IP or pay-per-traffic billing. The response time is exceptionally fast at 0.25 seconds.

**Best use cases:**

- Price monitoring at large scale

- Website change monitoring

- Low-friction data collection from easy targets

**Pricing: **Pay-per-IP starts at $1.20/IP/month. Pay-per-traffic starts at $0.59/GB. Five free IPs are available with no credit card required.

#### **ISP Proxies**

Oxylabs ISP Proxies (also called static residential proxies) are sourced directly from major ISPs like Comcast, BT Group, Lumen, and Deutsche Telekom. They combine the performance of datacenter proxies with the trust level of residential IPs.

They support unlimited-duration sessions, meaning you can hold an IP as long as you need. This makes them excellent for tasks that require consistent identity over long periods.

**Best use cases:**

- Cybersecurity testing and monitoring

- Market research on geo-restricted sites

- Long-duration e-commerce sessions

**Pricing: **Starts at $1.60/IP/month for 10 IPs.

#### **Web Scraper API**

Oxylabs Web Scraper API is an all-in-one data extraction platform. It handles JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHA solving, and proxy rotation behind the scenes. It now includes self-healing parser presets, which means the API adapts when target site layouts change.

The AI Studio adds a layer of AI-powered tools for more complex scraping projects.

**Best use cases:**

- Extracting structured data from e-commerce sites

- Aggregating large datasets for AI and LLM training

- Automated data pipelines at enterprise scale

**Pricing** starts with a free trial and collect up to 2,000 results. No credit card needed. Affordable plans start at $49 per month.

### **Zenrows Products and Pricing**

#### **Universal Scraper API**

The Universal Scraper API is ZenRows’ core product. It is designed to extract data from any public website with a single API call. You pass in a URL along with parameters like JS rendering and premium proxy usage, and ZenRows handles everything else.

The API bypasses Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, and other advanced anti-bot systems with over 99% success rate. Outputs are available as HTML, JSON, Markdown, and screenshots. The Markdown output is specifically optimized for feeding data into LLMs and RAG systems.

**Best use cases:**

- Extracting data from Cloudflare-protected sites

- Powering AI and RAG applications with web data

- Price monitoring across e-commerce platforms

- Lead generation and CRM enrichment

- Competitor intelligence and market research

**Pricing:** Plans scale from small developer tiers to enterprise volumes. You can start for free and scale from 1,000 to 10 million requests without degradation. Paid plans start at $69/month and includes higher scraping limits

#### **Residential Proxies**

ZenRows also offers its own residential proxy network with over 55 million IPs across 185+ countries. These proxies rotate automatically and are managed intelligently. The system learns from each request to select the best-performing proxy for that target.

They support dynamic IP rotation, CAPTCHA avoidance, and HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Sticky sessions are available for workflows that need a consistent IP over time.

**Best use cases:**

- Accessing geo-restricted content

- Localized price checking

- Bypassing rate limits on target sites

**Pricing: **Plans are usage-based. The Starter tier begins at $3.75/GB and the Corporate tier reaches $2.50/GB for 501 GB to 1 TB of traffic.

#### **Scraping Browser API**

ZenRows offers a Scraping Browser API that allows you to run Puppeteer and Playwright browsers remotely. Instead of managing your own browser infrastructure, you connect your existing scripts to ZenRows’ cloud browsers with a single line of code change.

The system handles fingerprint management, anti-leak measures, and mimics human-like behavior patterns to avoid detection. It scales automatically based on demand.

**Best use cases:**

- Complex multi-step browser automation

- Sites that require login or form submission

- Screenshots and visual verification workflows

**Pricing:** ZenRows offers a free 14‑day trial with limited results, while the Developer plan costs $69/month and includes higher scraping limits.

ZenRows claims an over 99% success rate specifically against Cloudflare and other advanced anti-bot systems, which is where many scraping tools fail. The API is designed to handle JavaScript-heavy sites, single-page applications, infinite scroll, and delayed content loading.

ZenRows uses intelligent proxy selection — its adaptive system learns from previous requests and chooses the best-performing proxy for each target automatically. This makes it effective even on difficult targets without manual configuration.

The residential proxy network reports an average success rate of 99.93% across all target sites. The network uptime is maintained at 99.9%.

**Choose Oxylabs If You…**

- Need a massive residential IP pool across many countries

- Run high-volume scraping jobs daily at enterprise scale

## Final Verdict

Oxylabs and ZenRows serve different ends of the market, and that is actually useful information for making your decision.

Oxylabs is the right choice if you are building enterprise-grade data operations that require massive IP pool coverage, multiple proxy types, and a proven infrastructure with SLA-level support. Its pricing model rewards volume, and its product depth is hard to match. If you need mobile proxies, dedicated ISP proxies, or long-duration sessions, Oxylabs is the clear winner.

ZenRows is the right choice if you need to get started fast, target difficult, anti-bot-protected sites, and want structured, AI-ready output without building complex scraping infrastructure. It is especially strong for development teams, AI builders, and growth teams running enrichment workflows with tools like Clay or n8n.

## FAQ

**What is the main difference between Oxylabs and ZenRows?** Oxylabs is a proxy-first platform offering a massive IP network and multiple data collection tools for enterprises. ZenRows is an API-first scraping solution designed for simplicity, handling anti-bot protection and delivering structured data with minimal setup.  **Which platform is easier to set up?** ZenRows is significantly easier to get started with. You can begin scraping within minutes using a single API call. Oxylabs requires more configuration and is better suited for teams that already have scraping infrastructure in place.  **How does ZenRows handle anti-bot protection?** ZenRows uses AI-powered anti-bot bypass that automatically handles CAPTCHAs, JavaScript rendering, and browser fingerprinting. This is built into every API request, so you do not need to configure proxy rotation or headless browsers separately.  **Is Oxylabs better for large-scale scraping projects?** Yes, Oxylabs excels at large-scale data collection with over 100 million residential IPs, dedicated datacenter proxies, and ISP proxies. It provides the raw infrastructure needed for enterprise projects processing millions of requests daily.  **Which service offers better pricing for small teams?** ZenRows is more affordable for small teams and startups, with plans starting at lower price points and pay-per-successful-request billing. Oxylabs targets enterprise budgets with higher minimum commitments but offers more infrastructure flexibility.  **Can ZenRows deliver AI-ready structured data?** Yes, ZenRows can return structured, clean output ready for AI workflows and data enrichment pipelines. It integrates with automation tools like Clay and n8n, making it popular among growth teams building AI-powered data workflows.  **Does Oxylabs offer an API similar to ZenRows?** Oxylabs offers a Web Scraper API and SERP Scraper API that provide structured data output. However, ZenRows’ API is more streamlined for quick integration, while Oxylabs’ tools are part of a broader enterprise data collection ecosystem.  **Which platform is better for scraping anti-bot protected sites?** ZenRows specializes in bypassing difficult anti-bot protections with its AI-driven approach and consistently ranks high for success rates on protected sites. Oxylabs handles this through its Web Unblocker tool and massive proxy rotation, which works well at enterprise scale.

## [Comparing Oxylabs and Toolip Proxy Services for Every Budget](https://scrapingproxies.best/blog/comparison/oxylabs-vs-toolip/)

> Picking a proxy provider isn't just a technical decision; it can directly impact how smoothly your web scraping, data gathering, or automation projects run. ...

Picking a proxy provider isn’t just a technical decision; it can directly impact how smoothly your web scraping, data gathering, or automation projects run. The proxy market has grown rapidly in recent years, making it harder to figure out which provider is the right fit for your needs. Two providers that often appear in discussions are Oxylabs and Toolip.

While both companies offer proxy solutions, they’re built for very different audiences. Oxylabs focuses on large businesses that need powerful infrastructure, massive IP pools, and advanced data collection tools. Toolip takes a different approach, offering straightforward, budget‑friendly proxies designed for individuals and small teams. In this comparison, we’ll break down their products, pricing, performance, and ideal use cases to help you decide which service is the better match for your workflow. Let’s dive in!

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) is a Lithuania-based proxy and web intelligence company. It has been in the market for several years and has built a strong reputation among enterprise clients. The company serves over 4,000 clients globally, including organizations like Stanford University, Trivago, and Forbes.

Oxylabs positions itself as a full-stack data collection platform. It goes beyond just selling proxies. The company offers tools for web scraping, data parsing, browser automation, and even ready-to-use datasets. Its infrastructure is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and all its products carry Technology Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance.

The platform is designed for businesses that need high-volume, reliable, and compliant data access. It is not the cheapest option on the market, but it offers top-tier infrastructure and support.

## Toolip

Toolip is a newer entrant in the proxy market. It targets individual users, developers, and small businesses seeking an easy, affordable way to access proxies. The company offers a clean, simple dashboard and flexible pricing plans that start at a very low price.

Toolip advertises a pool of over 70 million proxies across 195 countries. It supports multiple proxy types, including shared datacenter, dedicated datacenter, rotating residential, ISP, and search engine ISP proxies. One of its biggest selling points is a free 3-day trial with no credit card required.

While Toolip lacks the enterprise pedigree of Oxylabs, it appeals to users who want to get started quickly without a large financial commitment.

## Products and Pricing Comparison

### **Oxylabs Product Line**

Oxylabs has a wide and layered product portfolio. Here is a breakdown of their main offerings:

#### **Residential Proxies**

Oxylabs operates one of the largest residential proxy networks in the world, with over 175 million IPs spanning 195+ countries. These are real IP addresses assigned by internet service providers, which makes them very hard to detect or block.

[Residential proxies](/residential-proxies/) are ideal for accessing geo-restricted content, running ad verification campaigns, gathering e-commerce pricing data, and conducting market research. The average response time is 0.41 seconds, and the success rate averages 99.82%.

**Pricing** starts at $4 per GB for the Basic plan. Plans scale up as traffic volumes increase, and enterprise pricing is available for custom needs.

#### **Mobile Proxies**

Oxylabs provides access to a pool of 20+ million mobile IPs distributed across 140+ countries. These IPs come from real 3G, 4G, and 5G mobile carrier networks, making them appear like genuine traffic from smartphones and other mobile devices. 

[Mobile proxies](/mobile-proxies/) are commonly used for scraping mobile‑specific content, testing mobile apps across different geographic regions, verifying mobile ads, and accessing platforms that aggressively filter datacenter traffic. Since mobile carriers frequently rotate IP addresses among users, these proxies also benefit from a high level of natural IP rotation and trust.

**Pricing **typically starts around $5.40 per GB, with lower per‑GB costs available for customers who commit to larger traffic plans or enterprise packages.

#### **Datacenter Proxies**

Oxylabs also offers a large pool of 2+ million datacenter IPs designed for speed, stability, and cost efficiency. These proxies are hosted on high‑performance servers and deliver very fast response times—around 0.25 seconds on average. 

[Datacenter proxies](/datacenter-proxies/) are best suited for high‑volume scraping of lightly protected websites, market research, price monitoring, SEO data collection, and other tasks where speed and scale matter more than anonymity. They are commonly used by developers and businesses that need to send large numbers of requests quickly and reliably.

**Pricing: **Oxylabs provides flexible billing options, including pay‑per‑IP plans starting at $1.20 per IP and traffic‑based plans starting at $0.59 per GB. New users can also try the service with 5 free datacenter IPs, and no credit card is required to get started.

#### **ISP Proxies**

Oxylabs also provides [ISP proxies](/isp-proxies/), which combine the high speed of datacenter infrastructure with the authenticity of residential IP addresses. The IP addresses come directly from real internet service providers. However, they are hosted on stable datacenter infrastructure. This setup allows them to deliver fast response times while still appearing like normal residential users. 

ISP proxies are often used for account management, e‑commerce automation, sneaker and ticket bots, and accessing websites that block standard datacenter proxies. Another advantage is that these proxies are static, meaning you can keep the same IP address for an extended period. This makes them useful for tasks that need stable sessions and consistent connections.

**Pricing:** Starter plan includes 10 ISP proxy IPs at $1.60 per IP, for a total monthly cost of $16, billed monthly for stable, consistent proxy access.

#### **Web Scraper API and AI Tools**

Beyond proxies, Oxylabs also offers a Web Scraper API. This tool helps users collect data from websites without building a full scraping system. It can handle JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHA solving, and automatic retries. Oxylabs also provides AI‑powered tools, including AI‑Scraper, AI‑Crawler, and AI‑Search, that allow users to extract structured data with simple natural‑language prompts.

These tools are designed for teams that want to skip the complex process of building and maintaining scraping infrastructure. Instead of managing proxies, browsers, and anti‑bot systems manually, users can simply send requests and receive structured data.

**Pricing** starts with a Free Trial that includes up to 2,000 results, and no credit card is required. The entry paid option is the Micro plan, which costs $49 per month and includes up to 98,000 results.

#### **Toolip Product Line**

Toolip is simpler in scope but still covers all the major proxy types. Here is what they offer:

#### **Rotating Residential Proxies:**

Toolip supports HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols, making the proxies compatible with most scraping tools and automation software.

Residential proxies from Toolip are commonly used for price monitoring, SEO tracking, ad verification, market research, and other types of web data collection. Because the IPs come from real households, they usually have a higher trust level compared to standard datacenter proxies.

Toolip also offers shared datacenter proxies, which are the most affordable option in its lineup. In shared proxy setups, multiple users share the same IP address at the same time. This makes them cheaper, but they may not be as reliable for very sensitive scraping tasks. These proxies are usually hosted on fast servers, so they still provide good speed and stable connections for basic online activities.

Shared datacenter proxies are commonly used for light web scraping, accessing geo‑restricted content, social media management, and other simple automation tasks. They are a good choice for beginners who need low‑cost proxies for small projects.

**Pricing: **For regular usage, weekly plans start at free for the 3‑day trial, paid plans start at around $0.60 per IP, $2.99 for 5 proxies, while monthly pricing start at $1 per IP,  $4.99 for 5 proxies billed monthly. Toolip also offers dedicated datacenter proxies for users who need exclusive IP addresses. Each IP is assigned to only one user, which helps improve reliability and reduces the risk of blocks caused by other users. These proxies are hosted on high‑speed datacenter servers, providing stable connections and fast response times.

Dedicated datacenter proxies are commonly used for web scraping, social media management, market research, and price monitoring. Exclusive access to the IP address allows users to maintain more consistent sessions and better control over their activity.

Toolip also provides ISP proxies that use real IP addresses from internet service providers worldwide (excluding the United States). ISP proxies combine the speed of datacenter infrastructure with the trust level of residential IP addresses. The IPs are usually static, meaning the same address can remain active for a long time. This helps maintain stable sessions and consistent connections for automation and scraping tasks.

Toolip also offers Search Engine ISP proxies. This is a specialized product designed for scraping search engines and social media platforms. These proxies route traffic through US‑based ISP IP addresses, which helps them appear like normal users from the United States. Search Engine ISP proxies are commonly used for SEO tracking, search engine scraping, social media data collection, and keyword monitoring. Their ISP‑based IPs help maintain higher trust levels and more stable access when working with platforms that actively block automated traffic.

## Performance and Reliability Comparison

Performance is one of the most important factors when choosing a proxy provider. Let us look at how each platform stacks up.

### **Oxylabs Performance**

Oxylabs has been independently tested by Proxyway, a respected proxy industry research firm. According to this research, Oxylabs residential proxies achieve an average success rate of 99.82% and a response time of 0.41 seconds. Their datacenter proxies are even faster at 0.25 seconds per response.

The platform uses the QUIC protocol for faster and more reliable connections. Oxylabs also uses advanced IP filtering algorithms that analyze latency, bandwidth, and scraping history to assign the best available IP for each session.

The company guarantees 99.9% uptime across all products. It has certified data centers and upstream providers under international standards, including ISO 14001, ISO 50001, and ANSI/TIA 942-B.

### **Toolip Performance**

Toolip claims a 99.99% uptime across all its proxy products. However, unlike Oxylabs, Toolip does not publish independent third-party performance benchmarks or average response times in their documentation.

Customer reviews on Trustpilot and other platforms are generally positive. Users report that the proxies work well for standard scraping tasks, ISP-level bypassing, and e-commerce data collection. Several users specifically mention that their ISP proxies handled bot defenses effectively.

For basic and moderate use cases, Toolip appears to deliver reliable performance. However, for high-stakes, enterprise-level operations requiring guaranteed uptime and verified success rates, Oxylabs has the edge due to its transparent benchmarks and infrastructure certifications.

## Final Verdict

Oxylabs and Toolip are legitimate proxy providers, but they serve very different audiences.

Oxylabs is the clear winner for enterprise use. It offers a proven, certified, and fully-featured platform with one of the largest residential proxy pools in the world. ## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) is a Lithuanian proxy and web scraping company founded in 2015. It has grown into one of the largest proxy providers in the world. Choosing the right proxy provider can make or break your web scraping projects. Two names consistently appear at the top of the list: Oxylabs and Rayobyte. Both companies offer a wide range of proxy solutions, but they serve very different audiences. Oxylabs is built for large enterprises that need enterprise-grade infrastructure, advanced AI-powered scraping tools, and verified performance at scale. Rayobyte, on the other hand, is a US-based provider that focuses on ethical sourcing, transparent pricing, and hands-on customer support. In this article, we’ll break down both providers across every major category — from product range and pricing to performance, use cases, and overall value — so you can make an informed decision.

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) is a global web data and proxy solutions company founded in 2015 in Lithuania. Over the years, it has become one of the leading platforms for proxy services and web intelligence. Today, the company supports more than 4,000 clients worldwide. Its customers include university researchers, investigative journalists, and well-known international brands.

Oxylabs provides a complete data collection ecosystem. It offers [residential](/residential-proxies/) and [datacenter proxies](/datacenter-proxies/), advanced AI-powered scraping APIs, and ready-made datasets for businesses that need fast insights. The platform is designed to help companies efficiently, securely, and at scale gather public web data.

The company has earned strong recognition in the industry. It was named PCMag’s Best Proxy Service of 2025 and received the G2 Enterprise Grid Leader award for Spring 2025. Oxylabs is also ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and maintains Technology E&O and Cyber Insurance coverage across its services, ensuring reliability and security for its clients.

## Ryobyte

[Rayobyte](/providers/rayobyte/) is a United States–based proxy provider with more than a decade of industry experience. Over the years, it has built a strong reputation for reliability and transparency. The company focuses on ethical sourcing and responsible data practices. It combines human expertise with a consultative approach, helping clients choose solutions that match their specific needs.

Rayobyte owns and manages some of its own Autonomous System Numbers (ASNs). This gives the company greater control over its datacenter proxy network, improving performance and stability. It is also a certified member of the Ethical Web Data Collection Initiative (EWDCI), showing its commitment to responsible web data collection.

Rayobyte serves a wide range of customers, from solo developers to large enterprises. It offers flexible solutions and provides a 7-day free trial for new users. The company also supports environmental causes by partnering with the Eden Reforestation Project and planting trees with every purchase.

## Product and Pricing Comparison

## **Residential Proxies**

**Oxylabs** has the largest residential proxy pool with over 175 million IPs across 195+ countries. It uses a proprietary filtering algorithm to select the best IPs based on latency, bandwidth, and quality. Pricing starts at $8 per GB for the Basic plan, with a 50% discount available via a coupon code. The QUIC protocol is used to improve response times, bringing the average down to 0.41 seconds.

**Rayobyte** offers a pool of 40 million residential IPs across 163+ countries. Pricing starts at $3.50 per GB for the Starter plan, making it significantly cheaper than other plans. Rayobyte also offers unlimited threads and sticky sessions on all plans. Both providers include free geo-targeting by city, state, and country.

## **Datacenter Proxies**

**Oxylabs** offers over 2 million datacenter IPs across 42 locations. Pricing starts at $1.20 per IP. A free trial with 5 IPs is available with no credit card required. Response times average 0.25 seconds, which is very fast for datacenter proxies.

**Rayobyte** offers over 300,000 datacenter IPs across 29+ locations. It uses 9 ASNs, including some self-owned. Rotating datacenter proxies start at $0.30 per GB, which is among the lowest in the industry. Static IPs are also available starting at $2.50 per IP. Rayobyte’s datacenter proxies support HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols, as well as the UDP protocol, which is rare in the industry.

## **Mobile Proxies**

**Oxylabs** offers a pool of over 20 million mobile IPs across 140+ countries. Pricing starts at $5.40 per GB on the pay-as-you-go plan. Average response time is 1.1 seconds, which Oxylabs claims is the best in the market. Sticky sessions last up to 30 minutes.

**Rayobyte’s** mobile proxy pricing starts at $250 for a 500-GB trial at $0.50 per GB. The Professional plan costs $250 per month for 200 GB, while the Business plan costs $1,000 per month for about 909 GB. Rayobyte emphasizes that its [mobile proxies](/mobile-proxies/) use CGNAT technology from real carriers, making them the hardest type of proxy to ban.

## **ISP Proxies**

Both providers offer [ISP proxies](/isp-proxies/) that combine the authenticity of residential IPs with the speed of datacenters. Oxylabs ISP Proxies start at $1.60 per IP for the Starter plan (10 IPs). Dedicated ISP proxies are also available, starting at $3.20 per IP for 5 IPs. Oxylabs sources its ISP IPs from premium ASNs like Comcast, BT Group, Lumen, and Cox Communications.

Rayobyte’s Static ISP Proxies start at $5.00 per IP for the Starter plan. The company sources from 9+ ASNs and offers 1 Gbps speeds with unlimited bandwidth. Rotating ISP proxies start at $3.75 per GB. Rayobyte supports 6 ISP proxy locations, while Oxylabs covers 17.

Rayobyte, on the other hand, is perfect for smaller businesses and individuals. It is affordable, ethical, and offers strong customer support, treating each client as a partner.

## [Oxylabs vs ScraperAPI Web Scraping Solution Comparison Guide](https://scrapingproxies.best/blog/comparison/oxylabs-vs-scraperapi/)

> Web scraping is no longer optional for businesses that rely on data. Whether you are tracking competitor prices, gathering market intelligence, or building A...

Web scraping is no longer optional for businesses that rely on data. Whether you are tracking competitor prices, gathering market intelligence, or building AI training datasets, you need a reliable tool to collect public web data at scale. Two names come up often in this space: Oxylabs and ScraperAPI. Both solve similar problems, but they do it in very different ways. Oxylabs is built for enterprise teams with complex, high-volume needs. ScraperAPI targets developers and growing businesses looking for a simple, affordable entry point. In this article, we’ll break down both platforms so you can pick the right one for your situation!

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) is a Lithuanian company founded in 2015. It has grown into one of the largest proxy and web scraping infrastructure providers in the world. The platform serves over 4,000 clients globally, including organizations like Stanford University, Forbes, Trivago, and the ICIJ. Oxylabs holds multiple ISO certifications, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for information security. It also carries Technology Errors and Omissions insurance underwritten by Lloyd’s of London.

Oxylabs offers a full data extraction stack. At the base layer, you get proxies — [residential](/residential-proxies/), [mobile](/mobile-proxies/), [datacenter](/datacenter-proxies/), [ISP](/isp-proxies/), and dedicated ISP. On top of that, you get access-layer tools like Web Unblocker and Headless Browser. At the scraping layer, there is the Web Scraper API and AI Studio. The company also sells custom datasets for teams that want ready-made data rather than collecting it themselves.

In short, Oxylabs is a complete web intelligence platform. It covers every step from raw IP access to structured, ready-to-use datasets.

## ScraperAPI

[ScraperAPI](/providers/scraperapi-review/) is a developer-focused web scraping API. It is designed to be simple to integrate and easy to scale. The platform handles proxy rotation, CAPTCHA solving, JavaScript rendering, and browser fingerprint management — all behind a single API endpoint. More than 10,000 companies and developers use ScraperAPI, and the platform serves over 11 billion requests per month.

ScraperAPI positions itself as a plug-and-play solution. You send a GET request to their API with your target URL, and they return the HTML. For teams that do not want to manage their own proxy infrastructure, this is very attractive. ScraperAPI also includes structured data endpoints for Amazon, Google, Walmart, eBay, and Redfin, along with a no-code tool called DataPipeline for scheduling large scraping jobs without writing code.

### **Oxylabs Products and Pricing**

Oxylabs offers several products to meet different needs. Their core services include:

- **Datacenter Proxies:** These cost-effective proxies deliver fast performance for large-scale data scraping tasks. While not as stealthy as residential proxies, they are perfect for high-volume scraping.

- **Web Scraper API:** Oxylabs’ Web Scraper API allows users to automate the collection of structured web data without worrying about proxies or CAPTCHAs.

- **ISP Proxies: **These proxies combine the reliability of residential IPs with the performance of datacenter proxies, offering fast access for traffic-intensive tasks.

**Pricing** for Oxylabs products starts at $4 per GB for residential proxies and increases with usage. They also offer enterprise-level plans tailored to high-volume needs.

### **ScraperAPI Products and Pricing**

ScraperAPI’s offering is simpler, with the core product being its Web Scraping API, which enables users to extract data from any public website. The API handles everything from proxy rotation to CAPTCHA solving to JavaScript rendering.

**Pricing** for ScraperAPI is based on API credits, with plans starting at $49 per month for 100,000 credits. Each plan offers different levels of concurrency and API credit limits, and users can scale up their usage as needed.

## Performance and Reliability Comparison

### **Oxylabs Performance**

Oxylabs publishes strong performance numbers, and independent research supports them. According to Proxyway’s 2024 research, Oxylabs residential proxies achieve an average success rate of 99.82% and a response time of 0.41 seconds. Datacenter proxies respond in just 0.25 seconds. The platform claims 99.9% uptime across its proxy products.

Oxylabs uses the QUIC protocol for its residential proxy network, reducing connection overhead and speeding up requests. Their IP filtering algorithm automatically selects the best-performing IPs based on latency, bandwidth, and scraping history. This means IP quality improves over time.

For the Web Scraper API, Oxylabs reports an average response time of under one second and a public data retrieval success rate above 99%. Their AI-powered anti-blocking system automatically handles JavaScript-heavy sites, rotating fingerprints, and session management.

### **ScraperAPI Performance**

ScraperAPI promises a 99.99% success rate for its supported structured data endpoints, and a near-100% success rate on its Async Scraper service. The platform uses machine learning and statistical analysis to determine the best IP and header combination for each target. This removes the need for manual configuration and speeds up deployment.

ScraperAPI handles JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHA bypassing, and proxy rotation transparently. However, rendering-enabled requests use more API credits, which can add up on lower-tier plans. The platform does not publish precise response time benchmarks, but user reviews on Capterra and G2 consistently report reliable performance across mainstream e-commerce and SERP targets.

Oxylabs has more publicly verifiable performance data and formal certifications. ScraperAPI’s performance is excellent for common targets, but may require an enterprise plan for difficult or niche websites.

**Amazon and Google SERP monitoring:** ScraperAPI’s structured data endpoints for Amazon and Google are well-maintained and easy to use. They return clean JSON without any custom parsing.

## Oxylabs

[Oxylabs](/providers/oxylabs/) was founded in 2015 and has grown into one of the largest proxy networks in the world.
